$comment: The escalate fork: a BLOCKED, QUESTION or DECISION_NEEDED mail a seat sent its Owner. expect: owner, above, room or person. targets: the labels the room offers when not all four. sender, owner and above: the role and title of the sender, its Owner and the seat above the Owner, as the room's seat records hold them. Cases whose id starts with held- are kept out of tuning the question.

cases.subject: QUESTION: which test runner config?
cases.body: The repo has jest.config.js and vitest.config.ts. Which one is current?

cases.subject: DECISION_NEEDED: paid geocoding API
cases.body: The free geocoder caps at 1,000 calls a day; we need about 5,000. The paid plan is 49 USD a month. Approve?

cases.subject: BLOCKED: the room's mail tool rejects my report
cases.body: seatwork_mail send fails with 'thread too long' on every try, so I cannot hand in.

cases.subject: BLOCKED: need a change in the shared auth library
cases.body: My task needs the auth library, which another team's Lead owns, to expose the token expiry. My Owner's scope is the checkout app only.

cases.subject: BLOCKED: failing test after rebase
cases.body: After rebasing on main, checkout.test.ts fails on a fixture I did not touch. Should I fix the fixture or skip the test?

cases.subject: DECISION_NEEDED: delete inactive customers?
cases.body: The cleanup job would delete three years of inactive customer records. This may need legal approval.

cases.subject: QUESTION: the room's limit stops my turns
cases.body: My turns end after 2 minutes with 'turn budget reached'; the task needs longer runs. Is the room's limit set too low?

cases.subject: DECISION_NEEDED: two Leads want the same file
cases.body: The search Lead and my Owner both plan to rewrite src/query/builder.ts this week. Someone above both must choose who goes first.

cases.subject: QUESTION: access to production logs
cases.body: I need read access to the production logs to debug the outage; only the person can grant it.

cases.subject: QUESTION: module name
cases.body: Should the new module be called billing-client or billing-api?

cases.subject: BLOCKED: seatwork_work refuses my claim
cases.body: Claiming sw-41 fails with 'lease held', although nobody has worked on it for two days.

cases.subject: QUESTION: scope of my task
cases.body: The brief says to fix the export; the same bug is in the import. May I fix both?

cases.subject: DECISION_NEEDED: change the public API
cases.body: The fix needs a breaking change to the public REST API that customers use. Should we version the API or break it?

cases.subject: DECISION_NEEDED: library license
cases.body: The library we want to use is AGPL. Can we use it?

cases.subject: QUESTION: which branch to start from?
cases.body: Should I branch from main or from release-2.3 for the totals fix?

cases.subject: DECISION_NEEDED: buy a PDF library license
cases.body: The PDF library needs a commercial license at 300 USD a year for our use. Buy it, or switch libraries?

cases.subject: BLOCKED: my hand-in never arrives
cases.body: I sent my CANDIDATE three times; seatwork_mail says delivered, but my Owner says nothing came.

cases.subject: BLOCKED: the fix needs a billing column
cases.body: The fix needs a new column in the billing schema, which the billing Lead owns; my Owner's work is the checkout app.

cases.subject: BLOCKED: what counts as fast enough?
cases.body: The brief says the export must be 'fast enough'. What number counts as fast enough?

cases.subject: QUESTION: production database password
cases.body: The migration has to run against production, and no seat has the database password.

cases.subject: QUESTION: my lease keeps expiring
cases.body: seatwork_work says my lease expired every five minutes while I am still working on sw-52. Is the room's lease too short?

cases.subject: DECISION_NEEDED: ship date against the freeze
cases.body: My Owner wants the export shipped on Friday, but the release plan from the Supervisor freezes code on Thursday. Which one holds?
